relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF levels were significantly higher in the contralateral tissues than in the control rats (p<0.0001) and the ipsilateral tissues (p<0.0001).

relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: PRF may promote recovery from neuronal damage with concomitant restoration of TRPV1 and CGRP, and exert its analgesic effect by reversing BDNF increase.

key_findings: RTX lowered DRG TRPV1 and CGRP and raised BDNF; PRF of the sciatic nerve reversed these changes.
